dataset_description: Newer live telemetry collected during normal laptop use; not independently verified as entirely anomaly-free.
note: Exploratory v2 baseline trained on newer telemetry from normal laptop use. Normal-use data is not guaranteed to be free of anomalies. Calibration uses the final chronological 20% of this dataset; its tail fraction does not establish a future false-positive rate. Collection was interrupted, and no ground-truth live anomaly labels are available. Compare with v1 and review flagged events before deployment.
